{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_no_test = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_no_test['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the required values
print(f"Total revenue: {total_revenue}")
print(f"Number of completed non-test orders: {len(completed_no_test)}")
print(f"Number of internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99): {df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99].shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of invalid revenue values (NaN): {df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum()}"))"}
